source_of_truth: Original blueprint and v1 roadmap; AI execution replaces staffing only

requirements.requirement: iOS and Android public launch; phone and usable tablet; internal desktop only
requirements.verification: Native launch/install/update evidence on declared targets; no substituted web-only release.

requirements.requirement: Guest offline core, optional cloud, English externalized text and pseudolocalization
requirements.verification: Airplane-mode guest flow and localized-layout tests; fresh network services are separate dependencies.

requirements.requirement: Five producer prices/outputs, tier ratio 20, growth 1.12, previous-tier unlock at 10
requirements.verification: Reference conformance plus independent production precision and discrete-purchase boundary tests.

requirements.requirement: Single, milestone and maximum purchase controls and whole-tier 2x milestones at 25/50/75/100
requirements.verification: Bulk/max spending cannot overspend; tier output and displayed transformation agree.

requirements.requirement: Lifetime-based 0.65-exponent Rechart, entitlement subtraction, retained-state preview and permanent power
requirements.verification: Exact award boundary and repeated-reset tests; preview matches retained/reset state.

requirements.requirement: Autobuy at 10 Charts, synergies at 25, conditional resets at 100; free plan and five optional 50-Note slots
requirements.verification: Unlock and plan-persistence fixtures; no paid automation lock.

requirements.requirement: Cross-tier synergy matrix and honest marginal-output/purchase/reset forecasts
requirements.verification: Observed network value matches preview; forecasts state policy assumptions; late-tier purchase choices assessed.

requirements.requirement: 24 hours full production plus 48 hours at quarter rate; event-driven saved-policy replay
requirements.verification: Equivalent event histories match integer decisions; 72-hour cap and 24-hour return budget tested.

requirements.requirement: Focus every 2 hours, capacity 12, queued +20% ten-minute charges and equal accessible calibration
requirements.verification: No hidden reward loss, duration queue bugs or reflex-only route; both completions grant identical value.

requirements.requirement: Automatic 8-hour Surveys, queue capacity 3, 10 Notes per completion
requirements.verification: One daily collection retains designed supply; fractional timers persist and completion is idempotent.

requirements.requirement: Three daily contracts, 10 Notes and 250 XP each, frozen goals, rerolls and seven-day/21-slot backlog
requirements.verification: Seed/rollover/claim/overflow cases; no required prestige, ad or purchase objective.

requirements.requirement: Atomic saves, rolling backups, export/import, migrations and interruption recovery
requirements.verification: Contract validation is followed by runtime fault injection; schemas alone cannot pass persistence acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Cloud revision conflicts preserve branches; no adding divergent wallets/lifetime/offline intervals
requirements.verification: Two-device fork and recovery drill; merge only independently verified ownership and deduplicated receipts.

requirements.requirement: Explicit event ordering, numeric remainder policy and pinned economic versions
requirements.verification: Version transition settles old interval once; no numerical tolerance creates an unaffordable purchase or extra Chart.

requirements.requirement: Six chapters, ending and continued play; target 15–30 calendar days without hard time lock
requirements.verification: All goals reachable; observed later-chapter progression; ending independent of paid/optional completion.

requirements.requirement: Twelve challenge dossiers across three rule families, 100 Notes each
requirements.verification: All three families playable; exit/restart isolated; Note acquisition/entry cost validated.

requirements.requirement: Twelve authored calibration patterns with equivalent accessible completion
requirements.verification: Twelve actual patterns and their equal-value alternate paths are integrated.

requirements.requirement: Eighteen main archive entries and six optional 50-Note decorations; no forced full collection
requirements.verification: Content manifest, reachable unlocks and main-ending test with optional sinks unbought.

requirements.requirement: One harbor with initial plus six restored presentations; 25 producer presentations
requirements.verification: Actual integrated assets, all states and reduced-motion variants; registry counts do not imply completed art.

requirements.requirement: Season 1 Night of Returning Stars, 28-day lifecycle, isolated fleet, specified coefficients and no event prestige
requirements.verification: New/veteran equality; main power cannot enter; no economic export; actual live/end/archive behavior observed.

requirements.requirement: 30 levels at 500 XP, 30 free slots with 10 cosmetics/20 fragments, 10 premium cosmetics, selected archived pass
requirements.verification: 15,000-XP finish; single XP grant, one selected pass and paid-pass continuation after archive.

requirements.requirement: 36 unique cosmetics distributed 12 core, 10 free pass, 10 premium, 4 direct shop; supporter reuses shop items
requirements.verification: Unique IDs and actual assets match each reward; no power effect or unbudgeted supporter art set.

requirements.requirement: Ambient soundtrack, interaction/milestone/Rechart cues, independent controls and supporter soundtrack delivery
requirements.verification: Licensed actual audio files, playback/volume/mute tests and working purchased soundtrack delivery.

requirements.requirement: Cosmetic previews, localized price, verified purchases, restore, pending/retry/refund/revocation handling
requirements.verification: Native sandbox evidence on both stores; no fake adapter accepted; verified entitlement delivered once.

requirements.requirement: Equal ad/briefing six-token daily allowance; 300-second credits, speed/offline choice and additive buffs
requirements.verification: No-fill/refusal free path; +25% for 1200 seconds or bounded five-minute slice; +20% and +25% add to 1.45; full trajectories compared.

requirements.requirement: Settings, target input, readable numbers, contextual help and opt-in quiet-hour notifications
requirements.verification: Large text/reduced motion/non-color cues and critical controls work on named targets.

requirements.requirement: Help, recovery guide, release notes, credits, privacy/support URLs and runbooks
requirements.verification: All pages and review/support links work and match actual data and products.

requirements.requirement: No known save-loss, duplicate grant, negative wallet or undelivered verified purchase
requirements.verification: Fault/replay evidence; zero critical or major normal-progression/access/purchase defects at release.

requirements.requirement: Numeric parity: matching integer decisions; continuous error budget initially 1e-8 outside near-zero cases
requirements.verification: Production number policy specifies absolute floor and tolerance without changing award thresholds.

requirements.requirement: 99.5% crash-free sessions over 10,000 observed sessions, per platform/device and critical-flow review
requirements.verification: Real instrumented session denominator and device breakdown; no critical-flow crash left open.

requirements.requirement: 60/30fps targets, p95 startup ≤5s, 24h replay ≤3s, measured 30-minute battery/thermal usability
requirements.verification: Named physical devices and test conditions; p95 evidence; progress-visible chunking preserves owed work.

requirements.requirement: 15 new moderated testers and 80% comprehension target; first prestige 15–30 minutes among reachers plus non-reachers
requirements.verification: Actual study records; no bot population or artificial filtering is called user evidence.

requirements.requirement: 30/90-day simulations of visit/reset/buy/bonus strategies and Note scarcity
requirements.verification: No-bonus/free/ad full trajectories, 1/3/6 visits and 1,750-Note optional budget with unlock timing.

requirements.requirement: Real D30 and 28-day season, targets 500 starts/10,000 sessions; uncertainty and baseline tracking
requirements.verification: Full observation windows, retained churned installs in denominator, config/acquisition/exclusion records. Before enrollment preregister primary outcome and duration; state descriptive precision, and separately compute MDE/power for any causal experiment. Planning sample targets are not power guarantees.

requirements.requirement: D1/D7/D30 35/15/7% review hypotheses, strategy variety, welfare and commercial cost assessment
requirements.verification: Evidence-backed launch/extend/revise decision; no automatic retention waiver of correctness or fairness.

requirements.requirement: Current platform review, accurate listing, sandbox tests and final store acceptance
requirements.verification: Recheck official requirements near submission; accepted native builds and working products/reviewer access.

requirements.requirement: Monitoring, support diagnostics, backups, feature disables, rollout stops and compatible forward repair
requirements.verification: Staging and live-operation drills; never roll a newer save into an unsupported older executable.

requirements.requirement: 14 actual days of launch coverage, incident follow-through, final v1 record and Season 2 brief
requirements.verification: Dated operating report, fixes/owners and ongoing costs; future content is a brief, not unbudgeted production.

requirements.requirement: Privacy, consent/refusal, account deletion/export and service outages reflect actual SDK behavior
requirements.verification: Native network/SDK audit and lifecycle/outage tests; no policy page alone counts as implementation.

requirements.requirement: Reproducible native builds, explicit stack/toolchain feasibility and configuration compatibility
requirements.verification: Actual build/probe logs, pinned versions, safe defaults and rejection of incompatible updates.

requirements.requirement: Budget and device/test plan adapted to AI delivery; protect scope and independent review
requirements.verification: Execution costs and access needs named; no inherited human-week promise or unsupported tool capability claim.

requirements.requirement: Complete release evidence pack and approved candidate with only accepted minor issues
requirements.verification: Evidence from exact candidate/config/content versions; release status cannot be inferred from plan coverage.

requirements.requirement: Polish observed content/UI issues and create accurate store/launch assets
requirements.verification: Changed screens rechecked on targets; final screenshots/footage represent shipped product.

requirements.requirement: Mid/late progression adds meaningful decisions and at least two viable strategy/challenge approaches
requirements.verification: Combined simulation and observed play; no excessive daily-check-in or paid requirement for ending.
